scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npx wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4317 && npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.eas-build-post-install: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile-companion && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.validate:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:core && npm run test:desktop
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:fast && npm run test:integration && npm run test:durability && npm run audit:ci
scripts.validate:shared: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared
scripts.validate:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.validate:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.validate:mobile: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile-companion && npm run test -w apps/mobile-companion
scripts.validate:desktop: npm run build && npm run test:desktop
scripts.validate:storage: npm run test:integration && npm run test:durability
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run package -w @vitana/desktop
scripts.package:store: npm run build && npm run package:store -w @vitana/desktop
